'''Written Nosaurian''' was the written form of the [[Nosaurian (language)/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto's]] [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The writing system was composed of two separate alphabets, both of them ancient. Written Nosaurian also made use of a number of metaphors based on natural phenomena, especially seasons and weather.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
